notes.title: NEW UPDATE: Build 0.11.1!
notes.content:
Hello, Darrens!

Welcome to the new build! Here's what we've got:

1. One of the causes of the infamous Fatal Error has been destroyed! If you're still experiencing the Fatal Error, please let us know!

2. Four new Achievements have been added! Good luck getting "Kafka". 

3. Graphics options are now available on the "Options" screen. 

4. Some subtitle fixes, more being rolled out as we go. 

Our priority in the next bugfix is the Checkpoint-Just-Before-Death error. 

YA DIE

notes.title: Update A-Comin' + Live Shows
notes.content:
Howdy, Darrens!

Another update's been scheduled, if it's not gone up already. This one includes:

1. A bunch of technical stuff I didn't entirely understand, but I hear is super-useful!

2. The first batch of new achievements we're rolling out for Level 1!

Live Shows: 

13/10 Liverpool, Victoria Gallery - https://bit.ly/2CDhCO9 (daytime session for kids, but adults welcome)

26/10 The game is being exhibited for all of PAX AUS in Melbourne with a live The Dark Room show 9pm, 26th Oct in the EB Games Theatre - if you're in the neighbourhood, swing by the booth - and then come get screamed live at the show!

notes.title: Version 0.10.0 is Live!
notes.content:
UPDATES IN 0.10.0 

- The [spoiler]spoiler[/spoiler] is now, hopefully, permanently, dead. 

- The game's icon is now The Guardian's face on Windows. 

- The Fatal Error still exists at the end of The Bad Way Out. We will, however, destroy it, but first we must learn its ways.

notes.title: UPDATE: Version 0.9.2 is live!
notes.content:
Hello, Darrens! 

BEWARE <Spoilers!>

Update to the latest version - the [spoiler]puppy[/spoiler] is no longer immortal! I repeat, [spoiler] the puppy will not come back from the dead after it has been[/spoiler] killed. 

More changes, fixes as we go. The team is working on level 2 - remember, if you've bought level one, you get the whole game. 

YA DIE! YA DIE! YA DIE! (Especially the [spoiler]puppy[/spoiler])

notes.title: 21/10 - Update 0.8.0 + Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hey, Darrens!

New update! Version 0.8.0 includes the following features and bug fixes: 

1. Music is now in the game!

2. If you "reached level 2" and glitched yesterday, that was an old exit from a previous build - try again! Your exits are now... in another castle. 

3. THERE IS ONE TRUE PATH TO ESCAPE LEVEL ONE, AND SO FAR NOBODY HAS FOUND IT YET. A SACRIFICE WILL BE NECESSARY. 

4. Hard Mode / Adjust Brightness has now been made genuinely hard. 

As always, please report bugs here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/918530/discussions/0/1735465524701614928/

If you want to, please leave us a nice review on Steam. 

And if you want to send theories, maps or questions hit up @Robbotron on Twitter.
